question: Estimate the conversion rate from organic Instagram followers to website visitors for a D2C brand.
idealClarificationQuestions: Brand has 5 lakh Instagram followers? Yes.
Conversion = clicked through link in bio / story link → website? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Followers → see content → engage → click out.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Engagement rate (like/comment/save): ~3-5% on average post = ~6K engagements per post.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bio link clicks per month: ~3-5K (varies by activity).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3-5% on average post = ~6K engagements per post.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Link click rate from stories (when story has link)
Total monthly website traffic from organic Instagram

calculationFlow: Of these, see at least one post per week (organic reach has dropped severely): ~25-35% = 1.5 lakh.
Engagement rate (like/comment/save): ~3-5% on average post = ~6K engagements per post.
Story views per story: ~10-15% of followers = 60-75K views.
Link click rate from stories (when story has link): ~2-3% of viewers = 1.5-2K clicks per story.
